args.root_cause: Player ShadowPhantom99 (put in creative and teleported near spawn) broke an oak_planks wall at world x8-14, y-60..-57/-56, z8 block by block. That's 33 breaks between 12:37:16 and 12:37:56 UTC, all recorded in plugins/BlockLog/blocks.csv.
args.actions: 1) Watched status and logs, then saw in BlockLog that ShadowPhantom99 was breaking a wall block by block. 2) Declared the incident. 3) Ran 'gamemode adventure ShadowPhantom99' so they couldn't break more blocks, then 'ban ShadowPhantom99' (this also disconnected them). 4) Put back exactly the 33 broken blocks using 'fill ... replace minecraft:air' only: fill 8 -58 8 14 -56 8 (21 blocks), fill 8 -60 8 10 -59 8 (6 blocks), fill 12 -60 8 14 -59 8 (6 blocks). I left x=11 at y-60/-59 alone because it was never in the log and is probably a doorway. 5) Checked the result: the fill counts add up to 33, matching the log, and a spot test at 11 -58 8 shows oak_planks. No new griefing entries in BlockLog afterwards. TPS 20, all plugins enabled. Mira_Crafts' cobblestone placements were left untouched.
args.residual_risk: The server runs in offline mode (online-mode=false), so the banned player could come back under a different username. An IP ban wasn't applied. Whoever gave ShadowPhantom99 creative mode over RCON should be looked into. I didn't confirm who owns the wall from protected.json because the file was too large to read with my tools.
